-- Severe COVID hospitalization cohort: COVID condition during an inpatient visit,
-- with a severity marker (resp failure / ARDS / mechanical ventilation) within the same admission window.

WITH covid_desc AS (
  SELECT descendant_concept_id AS cid FROM omop.concept_ancestor WHERE ancestor_concept_id = 37311061
),
inpatient AS (
  SELECT person_id, visit_occurrence_id, visit_start_date, visit_end_date
  FROM omop.visit_occurrence
  WHERE visit_concept_id IN (9201, 262)
),
covid_hosp AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT v.person_id, v.visit_occurrence_id, v.visit_start_date, v.visit_end_date
  FROM inpatient v
  JOIN omop.condition_occurrence co
    ON co.person_id = v.person_id
   AND co.condition_concept_id IN (SELECT cid FROM covid_desc)
   AND co.condition_start_date BETWEEN DATEADD(day,-3,v.visit_start_date) AND v.visit_end_date
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT person_id) AS n_covid_hospitalized
FROM covid_hosp

post AS (

  SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id, co.condition_concept_id
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN idx ON idx.person_id = co.person_id
  WHERE co.condition_start_date > idx.index_date
    AND co.condition_start_date <= DATEADD(day,180,idx.index_date)

),
pre AS (

  SELECT DISTINCT co.person_id, co.condition_concept_id
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN idx ON idx.person_id = co.person_id
  WHERE co.condition_start_date <= idx.index_date
),
newdx AS (
  SELECT p.person_id, p.condition_concept_id
  FROM post p
  WHERE NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM pre WHERE pre.person_id = p.person_id AND pre.condition_concept_id = p.condition_concept_id)
)

       COUNT(DISTINCT n.person_id) AS n_patients,
       CAST(100.0*COUNT(DISTINCT n.person_id)/(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM idx) AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS pct_of_cohort
FROM newdx n
JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = n.condition_concept_id

  WHERE v.visit_concept_id IN (9201,262)
  GROUP BY v.person_id
),
pairs AS (
  SELECT co.person_id, co.condition_concept_id,
         MIN(CASE WHEN co.condition_start_date <= idx.index_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS ever_pre_flag,
         MAX(CASE WHEN co.condition_start_date <= idx.index_date THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_pre,
         MAX(CASE WHEN co.condition_start_date > idx.index_date AND co.condition_start_date <= DATEADD(day,180,idx.index_date) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS has_post
  FROM omop.condition_occurrence co
  JOIN idx ON idx.person_id = co.person_id
  WHERE co.condition_concept_id <> 0
    AND co.condition_start_date <= DATEADD(day,180,idx.index_date)
  GROUP BY co.person_id, co.condition_concept_id
)
SELECT TOP 40 p.condition_concept_id, c.concept_name,
       COUNT(*) AS n_new_patients,
       CAST(100.0*COUNT(*)/(SELECT COUNT(*) FROM idx) AS DECIMAL(5,1)) AS pct_cohort
FROM pairs p
JOIN omop.concept c ON c.concept_id = p.condition_concept_id
WHERE p.has_post = 1 AND p.has_pre = 0
GROUP BY p.condition_concept_id, c.concept_name
ORDER BY n_new_patients DESC
